name: Where are the best locations to install grab bars around a toilet?

mainEntity.name: Where are the best locations to install grab bars around a toilet?

acceptedAnswer.text: Optimal placement for toilet grab bars typically includes one bar on the side wall adjacent to the toilet and another on the wall behind the toilet. For toilets not against a side wall, a floor-to-ceiling grab bar or a hinged, flip-up bar mounted to the nearest wall can provide support. The exact height and angle are crucial and should be tailored to the user's specific needs, ensuring they can comfortably grasp the bar for balance and support when sitting down or standing up.
acceptedAnswer.description: Grab bars are best placed on the side wall next to the toilet and on the wall behind it, adjusted to the user's specific needs.
